parsed.summary: The PR simplifies the code by using subprocess.run and PGPASSWORD, but it removes the _escape_pgpass function which might be used elsewhere.

issues.description: The _escape_pgpass function is removed, which might be used in other parts of the codebase. This could lead to potential issues if the function is relied upon elsewhere.
